item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for SAP and Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for SAP is now available in limited preview, paired with Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent. The feature provides a workload-aware experience for operating SAP on Azure, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates
